releaseNotes.zh: 0.3 厨房首页、可调整的助手任务与工作流衔接。本周菜单按天查看，库存、菜谱、购物、菜单和做饭支持手动操作记录及冲突保护撤销。手动操作不消耗 AI 点，任务请保持前台运行。覆盖安装保留数据。
releaseNotes.en: 0.3 connects your kitchen home, adjustable Agent tasks and follow-up workflows. Browse menus by day; review and safely undo manual stock, recipe, shopping, menu and cooking actions. Manual tools use no AI credits. Keep tasks in the foreground and install over the existing app to retain data.
